kebab_example: aliyun cc5g create-authorization-rule --wireless-cloud-connector-id cc5g-xxxx --destination-type Cidr --destination 10.0.0.1 --policy Permit --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAuthorizationRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the 5G cloud instance
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The Name of the authorization rule. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 授权规则名称，长度不超过128字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the authorization rule. The description can be up to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 授权规则描述，长度不超过256字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The type of the destination. Valid values:
Cidr: CIDR block
Domain: Domain name or wildcard domain name
parameters.help_zh:
目标类型，取值：
Cidr: 网段
Domain: 域名或泛域名
parameters.name: destination_type

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type. Valid values:
icmp: Internet Control Message Protocol.
tcp: Transmission Control Protocol.
udp: User Datagram Protocol.
all: All protocols are supported
parameters.help_zh:
协议类型。取值：

icmp：网络控制报文协议。
tcp：传输控制协议。
udp：用户数据报协议。
all：支持所有协议
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The destination port range. Valid values:

For TCP and UDP protocols: 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and stop port with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200.

For ICMP protocol: -1/-1.

For ALL: -1/-1
parameters.help_zh:
目标端口范围。取值范围：

TCP、UDP协议：1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。

ICMP协议：-1/-1。

ALL：-1/-1
parameters.name: destination_port

parameters.help_en: The destination IP address or domain name
parameters.name: destination

parameters.help_en:
The policy of the authorization rule. Valid values:
Permit: Allow
Deny: Deny
parameters.help_zh:
授权规则策略，取值：
Permit：允许
Deny：拒绝
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en:
A unique token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter across different requests. The value must contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without creating the authorization rule. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are exceeded. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, the authorization rule is created immediately
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建授权规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建授权规则
parameters.name: dry_run
